# ui::MetroPalette

Header: `winui/ui/themes/MetroPalette.hpp`.

The Metro (Windows 8.1) base colors and border widths, as the Windows 8.1 light and dark themes define them.

[`Palette`](palette.md) is the Fluent counterpart and [`ClassicPalette`](classic-palette.md) the classic one. [`Theme::metro()`](theme.md#metro) derives every control's colors from this flat set of values. Start from [`metro_dark()`](#metro_dark) or [`metro_light()`](#metro_light). A default-constructed palette has every color zero apart from [`accent`](#accent). The era derives no accent shades: [`accent`](#accent), [`accent_hover`](#accent_hover) and [`accent_pressed`](#accent_pressed) are set separately, so a new accent means setting all three.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::MetroPalette palette = ui::MetroPalette::metro_dark();
palette.accent         = ui::Color::from_argb(0xFF008A00); // app accent instead of violet
palette.accent_hover   = ui::Color::from_argb(0xFF1FA01F);
palette.accent_pressed = ui::Color::from_argb(0xFF006E00);

ui::Theme theme = ui::Theme::metro(palette, /*dark=*/true);
window.pin_theme(std::move(theme)); // every control picks up the new colors
```

## page_background

```cpp
Color page_background
```

Page fill.

## foreground

```cpp
Color foreground
```

Primary text (0xDE alpha).

## foreground_secondary

```cpp
Color foreground_secondary
```

Secondary text (0x99 alpha).

## foreground_pressed

```cpp
Color foreground_pressed
```

Pressed-state text (0x66 alpha).

## button_background

```cpp
Color button_background
```

Rest fill of a [`ui::ButtonControl`](../controls/button.md#uibuttoncontrol). Transparent in dark, where the button is an outline, and a gray wash in light.

## button_border

```cpp
Color button_border
```

Outline color, drawn [`button_border_width`](#button_border_width) DIPs thick. Light draws no outline.

## button_foreground

```cpp
Color button_foreground
```

Label color at rest and on hover.

## button_hover_background

```cpp
Color button_hover_background
```

[Fill](../layout/fill.md#uifill) while the pointer is over the button.

## button_pressed_background

```cpp
Color button_pressed_background
```

[Fill](../layout/fill.md#uifill) while pressed. The button inverts: white in dark, black in light.

## button_pressed_foreground

```cpp
Color button_pressed_foreground
```

Label color while pressed, the inverse of the fill.

## button_disabled_background

```cpp
Color button_disabled_background
```

[Fill](../layout/fill.md#uifill) of a disabled button.

## button_disabled_border

```cpp
Color button_disabled_border
```

Outline of a disabled button.

## button_disabled_foreground

```cpp
Color button_disabled_foreground
```

Label of a disabled button.

## toggle_box_background

```cpp
Color toggle_box_background
```

[Fill](../layout/fill.md#uifill) of the [CheckBox](../controls/check-box.md#uicheckbox) box and the [RadioButton](../controls/radio-button.md#uiradiobutton) ring.

## toggle_box_border

```cpp
Color toggle_box_border
```

Outline of the box and ring, drawn [`indicator_border_width`](#indicator_border_width) DIPs thick.

## toggle_glyph

```cpp
Color toggle_glyph
```

The check mark and dot color, drawn on [`toggle_box_background`](#toggle_box_background).

## field_background

```cpp
Color field_background
```

Text-field fill. White in both themes, since text boxes stay light in the dark theme.

## field_text

```cpp
Color field_text
```

[Text](../controls/text.md#uitext) color inside a text field.

## field_border

```cpp
Color field_border
```

Text-field outline.

## menu_background

```cpp
Color menu_background
```

Menu and flyout fill. White in both themes, since every popup uses the light colors.

## menu_text

```cpp
Color menu_text
```

Menu item text color.

## menu_highlight

```cpp
Color menu_highlight
```

A hovered menu item's fill, a flat light-gray wash with black text. The accent marks selection in lists and combo boxes, and a menu item is never selected.

## menu_highlight_text

```cpp
Color menu_highlight_text
```

[Text](../controls/text.md#uitext) color of the hovered menu item on [`menu_highlight`](#menu_highlight).

## tooltip_background

```cpp
Color tooltip_background
```

Tooltip fill (white in both themes).

## tooltip_text

```cpp
Color tooltip_text
```

Tooltip text color.

## tooltip_border

```cpp
Color tooltip_border
```

Tooltip frame, 2 DIP wide.

## hyperlink

```cpp
Color hyperlink
```

Hyperlink text color, a lighter violet in the dark theme.

## separator

Color separator

## scrollbar_track

## accent

```cpp
Color accent = Color::from_argb(0xFF4617B4)
```

The accent, used as is for selection, checked toggles and progress. Defaults to the Windows 8.1 violet `#FF4617B4`.

## accent_hover

```cpp
Color accent_hover
```

Accent under the pointer, set separately from [`accent`](#accent).

## accent_pressed

```cpp
Color accent_pressed
```

Accent while pressed, set separately from [`accent`](#accent).

## button_border_width

```cpp
float button_border_width = 2.0f
```

[Button](../controls/button.md#uibutton) outline thickness in DIPs. The dark theme's button is a 2 DIP outline with no fill, and the light theme's is a borderless flat fill (0).

## indicator_border_width

```cpp
float indicator_border_width = 0.0f
```

[CheckBox](../controls/check-box.md#uicheckbox) and [RadioButton](../controls/radio-button.md#uiradiobutton) outline thickness in DIPs, the inverse of the button's: 0 in dark, 2 in light.

## metro_dark

```cpp
static MetroPalette metro_dark()
```

The Windows 8.1 dark theme, its default: a `#FF1D1D1D` page, outline buttons and white menus.

## metro_light

```cpp
static MetroPalette metro_light()
```

The Windows 8.1 light theme: a white page, borderless gray-filled buttons, and 2 DIP [CheckBox](../controls/check-box.md#uicheckbox) and [RadioButton](../controls/radio-button.md#uiradiobutton) outlines.
